titolo: Trump: Putin 'Wants Peace.' Zelensky: 'He Is a Killer.'
angolo: Day 5: Trump defends his 'friend' Putin at the White House while Zelensky answers 'killer', and the FT reports a hidden January deadline behind the rush.
descrizione: Trump: Putin 'Wants Peace.' Zelensky: 'He Is a Killer.' At a White House press conference, Donald Trump said Vladimir Putin wants to end the war, while Volodymyr Zelensky told CNN that for Ukraine Putin is an enemy and a killer. Putin, meanwhile, said Russia will not negotiate after the Crimean Bridge strikes. The Financial Times reports Washington wants a deal by early January 2027. We separate what is confirmed from what is only reported.

scene.testo: A US president calls Vladimir Putin his friend. A Ukrainian president calls Putin a killer.
Both said it within a day, on the same story.
Only one of them is reportedly working against a deadline.
Friday, the White House. Trump defends his ties to Putin at a press conference.
His words: a fantastic relationship with Putin.

citazione.testo: I consider that I have a fantastic relationship with Putin.

scene.testo: Hours earlier, Zelensky had answered on CNN, from Ukraine's side.
His answer: for Ukraine, Putin is an enemy and a killer.

citazione.testo: For us, he is an enemy, and of course, for us, he is a killer.

scene.testo: But a reported deadline may explain why Washington is moving so fast.
Start with the room where it all began.
Thursday, November 19. Shenzhen, southern China.
The first-ever trilateral summit of the leaders of the US, Russia and China, according to reports.
It lasted about 90 minutes, according to The Hill.
Before it, Trump met Putin on the sidelines.
Entering the room, Trump asked: who is that? Then answered himself.
Putin answered in English: nice to meet you.
It was their first meeting since Alaska, in August 2025, according to reports.
What did the three leaders actually sign in Shenzhen?
A four-point declaration. UN reform, oil supply, the ICC, and nuclear risk.
They said they intend to increase the production and supply of refined petroleum products.
They said a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought.
Arms control talks and any mention of Ukraine were missing, according to Reuters and RFE/L.
And the ICC point? The declaration included a critique of the International Criminal Court.
Reuters said the trip produced few tangible victories despite Trump's boasts. Trump called the summit 'bigger than Yalta'.
But Putin spoke right after. And he said something Trump did not repeat.
Days earlier, Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge.
A section of the roadway collapsed after a Ukrainian strike, according to reports; Ukraine said it damaged the road infrastructure.
Putin called the bridge an exclusively civilian facility. Kyiv argues it supports Russian logistics.
In Shenzhen, Putin said he had discussed limited ceasefires with Russia's Security Council.
Energy infrastructure. Commercial ships in the Black Sea.
Then he closed that door, publicly.

citazione.testo: After the strikes on the Crimean Bridge, we will not negotiate.

scene.testo: He also warned of a response far more painful than the bridge damage.
That was Putin's version. Now, Trump's.
On the flight home, Trump called into a meeting in Berlin, Axios reported.
scene.capitolo: THE CALL FROM AIR FORCE ONE

scene.testo: Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner were hosting European leaders and Zelensky, Axios reported.
The Coalition of the Willing summit in Berlin, hosted by Chancellor Friedrich Merz.
Trump's message, according to people in the room, quoted by Axios:
Putin, he said, wants the deal done.

citazione.testo: Putin wants to end the war, he wants the deal done, he is getting tired of this.

scene.testo: Kushner said Trump wants to make a deal with Europe by his side and is not looking to impose anything unilaterally.
In Shenzhen, Zelensky was asked about the warm greeting. He shrugged and walked on, Reuters reported.
A day later, the White House podium. And a new question.
Is Putin a friend of America? Trump said: 'I can't speak to America.'
But he insisted Putin has clearly expressed a desire to end the war by diplomatic means.
His explanation for the stalemate: Putin and Zelensky hate each other, he says.
He said the war, which he said should have lasted one day, has lasted five years.
And that Putin told him the war would not have happened if Trump had been president.
At home, the criticism came fast.
Senator Jeanne Shaheen, top Democrat on the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, called Trump's 'friend' a bloodthirsty war criminal.
Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Putin 'is not our friend and will never be'.
Zelensky's CNN answer went further. And it carried a warning.
If Putin is called a friend, he does not feel enough pressure, Zelensky said.

citazione.testo: If you speak about Putin, like he is a friend, of course he doesn't feel that he is a killer, he doesn't feel enough pressure.

scene.testo: But he conceded it is up to Trump how to call Putin.
He said the United States has huge instruments to pressure Putin.
Trump's own line on both men: they both want to end it, he said.
Now, the clock. The Financial Times reported something that may change the picture.
Washington wants a deal by early January, the FT reported, citing four people briefed on the talks.
Why January? Democrats are due to take control of Congress, per the FT.
Democrats are expected to seek more support for Ukraine and intensify sanctions pressure on Moscow.
According to the FT, Witkoff and Kushner conveyed that urgency in Moscow, Dublin and Berlin.
A source told the FT: the Americans are in a hurry, Putin is not.
A European official told the FT there was concern a deal would need a great deal of Ukrainian concessions.
A senior Ukrainian official told the FT Russia could get better terms before January.
The FT also reported, citing two people briefed on the Kremlin's views, that Moscow plans an air-strike campaign to gain leverage.
The White House did not respond to the FT's request for comment on the January date, the FT reported.
So here is where things stand, with what is confirmed and what is only reported.
Confirmed: Trump called Putin a friend and said Putin wants to end the war.
Confirmed: Putin publicly said Russia will not negotiate ceasefires after the bridge strikes.
Confirmed: Zelensky called Putin an enemy and a killer.
Only reported: the January deadline, sourced to the FT's anonymous sources.

visivo.testo: Only reported: the January deadline, sourced to the FT's anonymous sources.
